title: UTMB World Series — three levels, 2027 Majors list and Finals qualification
publisher: UTMB World Series / La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
claims: The UTMB World Series integrates three levels: the UTMB World Series Finals, the UTMB World Series Majors and the UTMB World Series Events.

The UTMB World Series Majors in 2027 are HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons and HOKA Canyons Endurance Runs (Americas), HOKA Val d'Aran and Wildstrubel (Europe), HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand (Asia-Pacific) and HOKA Ultra-Trail Australia (Oceania).

A Major grants the top 10 male and female runners in the 100M, 100K and 50K categories automatic qualification for the Finals and double the Running Stones of an Event; an Event grants the top 3 male and female finishers in those categories automatic qualification.
Running Stones can be collected only by finishing a UTMB World Series Event or Major, and at least one Running Stone plus a valid UTMB Index is required to enter the HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc lottery.
The page lists more than 70 UTMB World Series Events across the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa and Oceania.
